original_query: In which year may Subnational Debts be relieved more by Government, 2015 or 2016?

confirmed.answer_text: Subnational debts may be relieved more by the government in 2015.
cited_statements: For 2015, the amount to be relieved by government is 5994.78 (13.81%).
For 2016, the amount to be relieved by government is 4206.51 (9.69%).
